assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2.5D survival-game environment sprite, tier 1 of an upgrade family.
Primary request: ONE unlit small campfire base, an isolated low stone-ring hearth in charming HAND-PAINTED GAME ART. Match a lush hand-painted woodland game: chunky readable warm grey and taupe cobblestones with dark brown contour accents, soft painted facet highlights, rustic grey-brown oak, matte charcoal iron, sparse moss. Do NOT imitate a photograph or a realistic fire product render.
Subject: a low uneven ring of about 8–10 rounded-angular warm grey/taupe stones, with a very SHALLOW small battered charcoal-iron tray nested inside the ring, and exactly three short split charcoal-brown oak logs visibly resting in the central cavity. Iron is only a narrow shallow tray, not a barrel. Sparse moss in two outer stone gaps; one or two muted reused old bricks, discreetly mixed among stones. Humble scrappy charming camp construction.
Composition: single sprite, 1024×1024 square or highest practical square; front is at bottom. Oblique overhead / three-quarter game view, approximately 45–50 degrees from horizontal: clearly visible ellipse-shaped top and front faces. Match a hand-painted RPG world with cobblestone paths and rustic wood HQ. Orthographic feeling, no extreme perspective. Footprint about 75–80% of full canvas width, centered horizontally, lower footprint edge at y=85% of full canvas height. Reserve the entire top 25% mostly transparent and keep generous margin around all sides. Clear central open cavity and visible logs for later overlaying an animated flame.
Lighting: neutral daylight from upper-left, softly painted material shading, no lighting emitted by the hearth.
Background: REAL transparent alpha, isolated object cutout only. No ground tile, scenery, horizon, UI, cast ground shadow or backdrop. Transparent holes where appropriate.
Constraints: UNLIT. No flames, no orange embers, no glow, no smoke, no sparks, no labels, no text, no watermark. No photorealistic materials or noisy tiny texture. Strong silhouette and large quiet painted shapes readable at small gameplay size. No canopy, no grill, no tall industrial cylinder.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated transparent 2.5D game sprite, tier 2 upgrade of the supplied tier 1 hearth.
Input image: the supplied PNG is the hearth to upgrade, NOT a background. Keep its warm hand-painted game-art style, its camera/view angle, front direction, palette, stone shapes, weathered brown oak, charcoal iron and design family.
Primary request: upgrade this small unlit campfire into a REINFORCED STONE-AND-BRICK HEARTH. It must clearly look like the same low ring evolved one tier. Retain the original low uneven warm-grey/taupe stone ring and the exact three-log arrangement recognizably, but add a second LOW course of chunky stones with a few muted weathered reused red-brown bricks; a dark SLIM steel rim with modest rivets; and one simple low visible log cradle / short side log rest. Remain an open low bowl with a spacious central cavity. No grill across the cavity; no canopy; no tall industrial barrel.
Style: hand-painted 2.5D oblique-overhead woodland survival game, chunky readable shapes, dark brown outlines, softly painted facets, restrained texture. Not photographic. Warm neutral light from upper-left. The silhouette should be sturdier than tier 1 without much height. Sparse moss only in two outer gaps. Charcoal-brown logs with no glowing areas.
Composition: square 1024×1024 or highest practical square with actual transparent alpha. Front is at image bottom. Same elliptical top and front-face view as input. Object footprint centered horizontally, about 75–80% image width, lower edge near y=85%; entire object inside frame with generous margins. Top 25% mostly transparent. A later flame overlay will be anchored in the central log cavity.
Background and exclusions: transparent alpha cutout only, no scenery, no ground tile, no ground shadow, no background color, no labels, no UI, no watermark. Entirely UNLIT: absolutely NO flame, embers, orange lighting, glow, smoke, sparks. Do not add tall parts or span the open center with metal.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated transparent 2.5D game sprite, tier 3 sheltered camp hearth, upgrading supplied tier 2.
Input images: Image 1 is the tier 2 unlit hearth to upgrade; keep its identity, stone/brick/iron palette, three-log arrangement, and hand-painted appearance. Image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the weathered oak supports and patchy humble roof of the woodland HQ. Do NOT copy the old lit fire pit, terrain, UI, house or character from image 2.
Primary request: preserve the recognizable tier 2 open reinforced stone-and-brick pit with its visible charcoal-brown logs, and upgrade it into a SHELTERED CAMP HEARTH. Add a LOW thin slate/stone apron immediately around the bottom of the pit. Add exactly TWO rear weathered grey-brown oak supports reinforced with reclaimed charcoal iron brackets. These rear posts carry a SMALL SHALLOW LEAN-TO HOOD of muted brown/grey patchwork corrugated metal sheets situated at the BACK of the hearth. The practical salvaged woodland shelter echoes the HQ reference’s weathered oak and patched roof, without becoming a full building.
CRITICAL shelter composition: keep the hood narrow front-to-back and behind the fire cavity, in the upper-rear part of the sprite. OPEN FRONT AND OPEN SIDES. Camera must see the entire open elliptical fire bowl and the three brown logs clearly in lower-middle of image, below and IN FRONT of the hood. The canopy MUST NOT overlap or hide the central log/fire cavity. Rear vent gap, no smoke. No front posts blocking the fire, no grill, no ornate medieval details.
Style: the same warm hand-painted 2.5D overhead/three-quarter game sprite as the input hearth; chunky readable shapes with dark brown contours and painted facets. No photorealism or noisy grain. Warm taupe stone, muted used bricks, weathered grey-brown oak, matte charcoal iron, sparse moss. Upper-left soft daylight. No emitted firelight.
Framing: square 1024×1024 or highest practical square, real transparent alpha. Front at bottom. Whole object fully inside frame with generous margin. Lower footprint at around y=85%; approximately 75–80% canvas width. Top 25% mostly transparent. The small hood can occupy roughly y=28–48%, with bowl/log cavity around y=62–74% and lower front stones near y=85%. Reserve clear vertical opening in front of rear hood for a future flame overlay.
Hard exclusions: UNLIT. No flame, orange embers, glow, smoke, sparks or light halo. No scenery, vegetation beyond sparse seam moss, ground tile, cast ground shadow, houses, people, labels, text, UI, watermark, backdrop. Isolated hearth cutout only. Do not fill clear cavity with roof or a wall.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: flame-only transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted 2.5D survival game.
Primary request: ONE transparent image containing EXACTLY 8 separate isolated campfire flame clusters arranged in exactly FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, in eight equally sized cells. Preferred canvas 2048×1024, aspect ratio 2:1, or largest practical 2:1 canvas. Each cell must contain one flame and only one flame. This is animation artwork, not a diagram; do not draw cells, borders, guides or labels.
Style: hand-painted game sprite matching chunky woodland RPG art, warm bright orange, golden-yellow and cream tongues, clear warm-dark painted edge accents. Strong simple readable flame silhouettes, broad tapered licks, softly painted internal cores; NOT photorealistic wispy fire, not smoke.
Loop consistency: the eight frames show the SAME campfire flame gently flickering. Same approximate height and width, changing only side bends, tongue shapes and internal tongue details. Flame size breathes by no more than plus/minus 5%, never vanishes. For each equal cell the flame ROOT is at exact horizontal center x=50% and BASELINE y=85% of the cell. All clusters start from that same root/baseline; no whole-frame translations. General top near y=20%, flame width about 45–50% of cell. Generous wholly transparent gutters on every side so adjacent flames never touch. Read frames left-to-right on top row then left-to-right on bottom row, gentle looping motion.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, all empty areas fully transparent; orange/gold/cream opaque interiors and subtle translucency only at the flame edges. No colored rectangle, no fake checkerboard.
Hard exclusions: absolutely NO stones, logs, wood, metal, fire bowl, base, ash, charcoal, ground, scenery, particles, sparks, floating detached wisps, smoke, glow halo, shadows, text, numerals, labels, cell borders or watermark. FLAME ONLY. Exactly 8 clusters, 4 columns × 2 rows.
